findingsAndDispositions: The initial immutable-local claim exceeded typed-AST evidence because TVar does not preserve source final; renamed the admitted behavior to initialized Int local.
The typed capability authority initially named a WordPressHx Bead and violated generic package isolation; replaced it with a neutral reflaxe.php runtime-semantics owner.
Every admitted compiler branch now requires a typed capability marked admitted, while the checked JSON projection is generated from that Haxe authority and rejects stale or mutated copies.
Numeric evidence is intentionally limited to small Int literals, addition, and equality; overflow, division, modulo, coercion, and platform-width behavior remain unverified-owned.
Strict PHP equality is justified only by the currently validated Int operands and is not generalized to dynamic or foreign values.
Source mutation and foreign/runtime/stdlib boundaries remain outside this slice and are retained as explicit unsupported or unverified capabilities.

The cross-module call now emits as two independently mapped type artifacts plus a source-derived dependency-ordered bootstrap; wordpresshx-reflaxe-php.7 owns that output-shape evidence separately from this semantic matrix.
Required Int signatures lower to native PHP int types under strict_types=1; optional/default, non-Int, and foreign static call fixtures fail before any PHP or map is published.
Haxe typing supplies arity and argument-type admission for the exact static call, while target ownership and the called method signature are independently constrained by the compiler preflight.

The loop slice admits only explicit assignment to typed Int variables, Int <=, and normal pre-test while; compound assignment and do-while have source-positioned compile-negative owners with no partial output.
The small finite accumulation fixture does not establish loop termination, integer overflow, break/continue, increment/decrement, or generalized mutable storage semantics.
The array slice admits only direct Array<Int> literals and constant reads whose bounds are proven from that typed local; dynamic and out-of-bounds reads fail before publication.

Stock Haxe returned null for the out-of-bounds fixture while native PHP emitted an Undefined array key warning, so direct arbitrary PHP indexing is intentionally withheld until an owned runtime representation can preserve Haxe behavior without hidden stderr.
Array mutation, length, aliasing/references, iteration, ordering, mixed/null elements, nested arrays, and general collection/runtime semantics remain unsupported or unverified.
The String slice accepts only operands already typed as String; a compile-negative numeric-coercion fixture prevents silently inheriting PHP coercion rules.

The UTF-8 transcript directly observes a three-byte arrow and four-byte non-BMP rocket under stock Haxe and PHP, while String length, indexing, normalization, invalid Unicode, parameters, and returns remain unverified or unsupported.

The first Unicode lowering attempt exposed that Haxe source positions are Unicode-character offsets rather than UTF-8 bytes; the generic source registry now converts them, a focused scalar-width unit test pins the boundary, and the independent Python verifier checks every statement mapping.
Required non-null String parameters and returns lower to native PHP string signatures only for compiler-proven source-owned calls whose arguments are admitted String expressions.

Stock Haxe without strict null safety accepted a null String argument and printed null, so the custom compiler rejects that otherwise valid source before emission instead of claiming PHP string/null parity.

Every compile-negative fixture now executes successfully under stock Haxe with empty stderr before the custom compiler is required to reject it, preventing an invalid Haxe program from masquerading as a backend boundary test.
PHP strict_types is selected by the caller; therefore handwritten weak-PHP callers and public adapter ABI behavior remain outside this source-owned Haxe call claim.
